spans.text: The truth is often shrouded in mist.
When you wade into the brume, there's no telling what you'll run into first, be it monsters, sheer cliffs over a bottomless abyss...
Or a little girl's ball of string...
However, that will not stop the seekers of the truth.
They will strike down the monsters, cross the abyss and follow the string forward, until the truth is revealed before their eyes—
A week after the end of the battle at the submarine base, in the forward operating base in Griffin-controlled Area S09.
Woohoo! We're back!
Kalina's joyous cheer at the empty front entrance of the base goes unanswered.
She slowly lowers her arms and turns around.
Welcome back, Commander!
You know we've been back for several days now, right? You don't need to put on such a display.
But I WANT to!
Also, before this, we were stationed at the base that Mr. Havier lent us. It was just a place to rest our heads.
But now we're back at the base that truly belongs to us. I can't help feeling sentimental about it!
Really now?
I actually felt more comfortable living in the new base.
Honestly, Commander... You don't have a romantic bone in your body...

(Sighs) The past few days were a total pain in the ass, with a gang of people in suits asking us all kinds of questions the moment we got back to base. Fortunately, they didn't seem interested in our Dolls.
They didn't manage to find the "baddies" mixed in with our Dolls either.
...It scared the hell out of me back then.
Still, they are absolute pros at pretending to be Dolls.
If you ask me, they seemed to be having fun with it.
Is everyone settled in?
Of course they are. There aren't any problems whatsoever. It's just that everyone's resting so the hallways are empty.
The base feels kind of lonely when it's so quiet, though...
It won't be like that for long. We've got several hundred Dolls' worth of neural cloud backups to restore, you know.
Hm... Will you give me a hand when the time comes, Commander?
No need to worry about that.
A voice comes from the far reaches of the main halls, and a familiar figure approaches the two of them.
I'll transfer more logistics staff to this base to help you recover your Dolls' fighting strength.
Ah, Miss Helian! You're back too!
Yes, I'm back.
I've been worrying about you ever since you left with those men in black when we got off the plane...
Rather than worry about me, why don't you use this free time to update the Dolls' tactical directives?
Also, I'm sure there are numerous combat logs waiting to be compiled into combat reports.
(Groans) Well, that's Miss Helian for you, she went there right away...
Our Dolls have gone through a lot of hard battles, and the records of those battles are very important assets for Griffin.
However, there's no hurry in doing that yet.
After everything that's happened, I believe the two of you need a good, long vacation.
A vacation?
Is...is that really okay?!
It's safe now, and you don't need to go around with your nerves on edge all the time.
God knows the two of you deserve it. Thank you both for your hard work.
That's wonderful, Commander!
Ahhh, what should we do now that we've got some time off?
I want to eat ice cream, go shopping, get new clothes... Also, I want to see if there's anything new and interesting that we can procure for the base...
And then you'll fleece the Commander and use the profits to buy your favorite snacks?
Aw, you're mean, Miss Helian~
You don't mind if I earn a little extra for myself, right, Commander?
Actually, that's a little...
You don't mind right?
Just a teensy~ weensy~ little~ bit~
Er...no...no, I don't mind, I guess...
You're the best, Commander!
Money's good, but you're better!
Alright, Kalina, stop giving the Commander a hard time.
As it happens, while we're on the subject... We can lighten the burden that we're putting on our logistics and supply Dolls.
Griffin's supply chains have been completely revamped after everything that's happened, so we'll be operating under new resupply directives.
Huh? So we won't be using our previous suppliers anymore?
That's right.
We don't have to worry about supplies. Somebody's taken care of that for us.
Somebody's taken care of that for us... Does that mean we won't need to spend money on supplies at all?
You always pick up on weird things like this...
But yes, you're right. However, they've got problems of their own to deal with, so it'll take a few more days for our supplies to arrive.
Is it Havier?
Correct. The operational costs for this base will all be borne by a certain IOP trust fund, so you won't have to worry about money in the short term.
Ah... Mr. Havier has sure been a great help, but his requests are almost always extremely deadly...
He has given us a lot of help. You should be grateful, Kalina.
Well, I'd be more grateful if he gives us better supplies...
Now that you mention it, where have you been the whole time?
My heart nearly skipped a beat when you suddenly stepped out of the helicopter at the sub base.
Mr. Kryuger needed me more back then.
I apologize for not being able to help you during your time of need.
Aw, that's not what I meant, Mr. Kryuger's very important too!
Uh... Wait a minute, does that mean Mr. Kryuger is safe now?
He is no longer in danger thanks to your victory.
That's wonderful!
So is he...?
Indeed. He's on the way to this base.
I know this is asking a lot of you, Commander, but please secure the perimeter around the helipad.
I doubt any of us wants anything to go wrong at the final step.
Understood. I definitely agree with that.
Then I'll go make preparations to receive him. I'll be counting on you in the meantime.
